feeds.title: Street Musician Daniel

feeds.title: Jimmy Talksalot
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jimmy and this is my blog for learning busking. I am a sidewalk performer from New Orleans. I travel up and down sidewalks all over the world, doing my show for whatever people feel they should pay me. Follow this blog on how to street perform as a magician.

feeds.title: PM Juggling
feeds.description: PM Juggling is a very small maker. We make props in a small workshop every day. But we are not alone. Props connect us to many jugglers. Our props can evolve thanks to the connection with many people. Follow to get the latest articles from this feed in your inbox.
